description: PAPER PREVIEW (sealed:false, is_keep:false, paper:true). Not a verdict; for a verdict use get_lab_desktop_handoff. Block bootstrap: resamples the net-of-fee trades of the full backtest of an ArenaScript strategy (the Lab's Rust engine, seed derived from the trade fingerprint, minimum 10 trades). Returns the percentiles of simulated equity, input_scope and the quota; the historical win frequency is neither a predictive probability, nor independent proof, nor a KEEP. Public pool: 8 per day per client, shared with play_public_round. engine_robustness_check(holdout_percent=0) gives exactly the same Monte Carlo.
name: monte_carlo
